49 def tuya_sign(secret: str, client_id: str, t: str, nonce: str,
50               string_to_sign: str, access_token: str = "") -> str:
51     """HMAC-SHA256 signature, upper-hex — the exact Tuya Cloud OpenAPI algorithm.
52 
53     For a token grant, ``access_token`` is empty; for a business request it is the
54     granted token, inserted right after ``client_id`` per the spec.
55     """
56     message = f"{client_id}{access_token}{t}{nonce}{string_to_sign}"
57     return hmac.new(
58         secret.encode("utf-8"), message.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256
59     ).hexdigest().upper()
